faq.q1: How can I book an appointment with a specialist?
faq.a1: Select your preferred department and doctor, choose your date and time, enter patient details, and confirm the appointment. You can also call +94 11 234 5678.
faq.q2: Can I reschedule or cancel my booked appointment?
faq.a2: Yes. You can reschedule or cancel your appointment at least 4 hours before your scheduled time slot through your Patient Dashboard.
faq.a3: Yes. MediCare Plus supports online payment options through the Payment page using Credit/Debit Cards, Online Banking, and Mobile Wallets.
faq.a4: Yes. Emergency services operate 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, 365 days a year with trauma surgeons and mobile ICU ambulances.
faq.q5: What is the emergency contact hotline?
faq.a5: For immediate medical emergencies, call +94 11 999 9999 or tap the floating red emergency button on our website.
faq.q6: Do you offer cashless health insurance claims?
faq.a6: Yes! MediCare Plus partners with all major international and Sri Lankan insurance providers. Our Insurance Desk assists with cashless hospitalization.
faq.q7: Do I need to fast before taking a Full Body Checkup?
faq.a7: Yes. Comprehensive health checkups covering blood sugar and lipid profiles require 8 to 12 hours of overnight fasting.
faq.q8: What are the ward visiting hours?
faq.a8: Regular ward visiting hours are 11:00 AM - 1:00 PM and 4:30 PM - 7:00 PM daily. ICU visiting is restricted to immediate family.
faq.q9: How do I download my lab reports online?
faq.a9: Log into your MediCare Plus patient profile, navigate to My Records, and download PDF lab test reports instantly.
faq.q10: Is the hospital pharmacy open 24 hours?
faq.a10: Yes, our inpatient and outpatient hospital pharmacies operate round-the-clock with genuine prescription medications.

about.timeline_2026_desc: Integrated AI diagnostic assistance, robotic joint replacement suites, and 3D imaging.
